quirks_resolved.body: These are community routes: individual publishers (e.g. AkshayCoder48 "FreeAIXYZ", NamanSoni78, morriszdweck) register relays in Pollinations’ registry, and the catalog lists only the ones priced at zero Pollen. A publisher can re-price, rotate or withdraw a route, and Pollinations can delist it from the public registry, without notice; delisted routes may keep answering for a while. Use the 10 RPM per-user ceiling shown in the catalog and expect occasional fail-over.
